summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration file that defines two services: a Joomla web application and a MySQL database. The Joomla service exposes port 8080 and connects to the database, while the database service stores its data persistently. Both services run with the same non-root user ID for security and file permission consistency.

explanations.8: The %% notation is a placeholder that gets replaced with an actual port number (in this case 8080) at runtime; the format means 'external port:internal port' so traffic on your machine's port 8080 reaches the container's port 80.
explanations.13: This sets the user ID and group ID (1000:1000) that the Joomla container runs as, instead of root, which is a security best practice to limit damage if the container is compromised.
explanations.17: This mounts a folder from your machine (./site_joomla) into the container's /var/www/html directory, so Joomla files persist on your computer even if the container stops.
explanations.25: Like line 13, this runs the MySQL database as user 1000:1000 instead of root for the same security reasons.
explanations.29: This mounts a folder from your machine (./db) into the container's data directory, so the database files are saved on your computer and survive container restarts.
